scope: Coats of arms (Wikidata P94) for every Nestlyzer country, matched by the official code property the place pages use; each query from Wikidata and, as a backup, QLever
note: Nestlyzer 2.15.30-r7: run once by .github/workflows/nz-collect-once.yml after a release is published. Bounded, read-only; files over 95 MB are refused (GitHub file limit). Results go to the branch data-intake-<plan hash>, never to the website.
